item.title: FDA COVID Vaccine Safety Report
item.description:
• Summary: An FDA report concludes that no child deaths have been definitively caused by COVID-19 vaccination, reinforcing the safety profile of mRNA and other authorized vaccines in pediatric populations.
  • MoAs: mRNA vaccines (e.g., BNT162b2, mRNA-1273) encode spike protein; viral vector vaccines (e.g., Ad26.COV2.S) use adenovirus vector
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Ebola Travel Ban and Vaccine
item.description:
• Summary: This STAT News article examines the debate over implementing travel bans in response to Ebola outbreaks and the role of existing vaccines in control efforts. It discusses the efficacy of the older Ebola vaccine (rVSV-ZEBOV) and the potential public health consequences of travel restrictions.
  • MoAs: Ebola vaccine (rVSV-ZEBOV/Ervebo) - live attenuated recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus vector expressing Zaire ebolavirus glycoprotein
  • Sources: STAT News
